text:
auditor_lee: Morning team — audit on Thursday. We need a compact evidence drop: all RBAC changes in the last 90 days, a single end-to-end trace (PR -> CI -> kube audit -> KMS), proof of service-account deprovs (token revocation or key deletion), and mapping to controls (SOC2 CC6.x, ISO A.9). ETA for delivery?

nina_sec: We can put together rolebinding_changes.csv + a traced_example directory. CSV cols: pr_id, author, approver, cluster, binding_name, principals_added, principals_removed, jira_ticket_or_na, rationale_short. We'll flag rows tied to vuln tickets. ETA 18:00 local.

tom_oncall: I'll produce the RBAC diffs by diffing infra repo commits and matching PR metadata. For the traced example I'll include PR URL, approval screenshot, CI build id, and pipeline logs.

rachel_infra: For cluster/audit evidence I'm going to pull apiserver audit entries and cloud KMS usage. Splunk query I'll run for kube audit (slightly different extraction):

```splunk
index=k8s_audit source="/var/log/kube-apiserver" "RoleBinding" OR "ClusterRoleBinding" | where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d") | rex field=request.verb "(?<verb>create|update|patch)" | table _time host user verb objectRef.name objectRef.namespace annotations.pr_id requestID
```

rachel_infra: For KMS (aws) I'll use Athena on CloudTrail parquet with this filter to capture both GenerateDataKey and Decrypt events filtered by principal or key alias: 

```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId, resources FROM cloudtrail_parquet WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey','Decrypt','Encrypt') AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date) AND (requestParameters.keyId IN (select key_id from known_keys) OR userIdentity.principalId IN (select principal from rbacs))
```

nina_sec: One ask from auditor: please include absolute ISO8601 timestamps with timezone for all exported logs and the PR approval screenshot must show approver name + timestamp.

auditor_lee: Also include a short timeline.csv with columns: event_time_iso, component, actor, action, evidence_path — makes cross-correlation easy.

tom_oncall: Noted. For service-account deprovs I'll add last_auth_iso and deletion_event_id (or rotation_ticket). If a token was revoked, I'll include the revocation event from auth-telemetry.

rachel_infra: Uploading preliminary evidence bundle to presigned link: https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/xy7v9k12 (valid 72h). Bundle contains: rolebinding_changes.csv, traced_example/{pr.png,pipeline.log,kube_audit_snip.txt,kms_row.csv}, service_account_deprov.csv, control_mapping_brief.pdf, README.txt.

logbot: artifact-uploaded evidence-bucket/engsec/4400001234_audit_bundle.zip (expires in 72h) :package:

nina_sec: I'll add a one-page control mapping that shows which file satisfies SOC2 CC6/CC7 clauses and ISO A.9.2/A.12.4 references. Also will include a short note on evidence retention and chain-of-custody for the bundle.

auditor_lee: Great, thanks. One follow-up: for any RBAC change tied to a vulnerability ticket please include the triage summary (2 lines) and the ticket link.

tom_oncall: Will mark those rows with jira IDs like SEC-4833 and SEC-4902 when applicable. If change not vuln-related I'll put N/A.

nina_sec: Final drop planned EOD local time. README will list nina_sec as primary contact and tom_oncall as backup.

auditor_lee: Perfect. I'll download and spot-check; will post any clarifying questions here. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
